sources.citation: hand-made by S18 from the rules of hold'em: five specific combos a side that avoid the test flops, so a real flop solve finishes in seconds in release (O-178, O-181)

notes: Ten combos in total, chosen so none holds a card of Ah7d2c, the flop of the integration tests and of tiny-bb-btn-srp.spec.json.
Not a strategy: the ranges exist to make the builder's real-solve tests small. Nothing here comes from a reference tool (O-26).
